scripts.name: Worktree setup
scripts.command: main=$(git worktree list --porcelain | sed -n '1s/^worktree //p'); (cd "$main" && fd -HI -t f -E node_modules -E .git -E .claude -E .data -E .pnpm-store -E .scratch -E .wrangler '^\.env' .) | rsync -a --ignore-existing --files-from=- "$main/" ./; mise exec -- pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --prefer-offline
